exposure: Women with higher maximum pain scores after fSB repair
Pain levels after fSB repair (5 groups)
cohort: 67 women who underwent open fetal spina bifida repair followed by C-section
finding: Women who underwent open fetal spina bifida repair experienced higher maximum pain scores, greater sleep disturbance due to pain, and higher sedation rates compared to after their subsequent C-section, but generally found the pain management satisfactory.
